CheckTitle: Ensure Fusion Applications Login, Logout and Session Events are Captured, Exported, and Forwarded to Central Logging
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Identity domain REST API (read-only admin app role, e.g. Audit Administrator + Security Administrator)
OCI tenancy access (IAM policies, Fusion environment settings, Logging, Monitoring)
Description: All authentication lifecycle events (successful and failed sign-ins, sign-outs, session creation and termination) should be captured, exported to OCI Audit/Logging and forwarded to a SIEM for retention and alerting.
Risk: Without these events, account compromise, brute force and session misuse go undetected.
AuditProcedure: Confirm the Fusion audit export to OCI Logging or Object Storage is configured.
Search for recent session events (sign-in success/failure, sign-out, session created).
Confirm the Service Connector Hub pipeline to the SIEM is operational.

Steps: Configure the audit export and an ingestion pipeline (Logging > Connector Hub > Streaming/SIEM).

DefaultValue: Events are recorded internally; export and forwarding are not configured.
Notes: Automated part: whether the identity domain records each lifecycle event. Export and SIEM forwarding need OCI access.
